messages:
evan: Morning — saw ~110 webinar signups stuck with no owner in HubSpot. Most from the lightweight form, landed overnight :grimacing:
priya: yikes. Is this the enrichment owner lookup again?
mike: yep. enrichment svc returned a bunch of 503/timeout for ~12min during the midnight deploy window. Our workflow gives up and moves leads to the fallback queue
zoe: quick idea: build a tiny 'backstop-assigner' that sets a provisional owner `unclaimed-webinar` after X seconds but leaves a note so SDRs know to reconcile. That way reps get something in their queue instantly
evan: I like the provisional owner approach. we should also keep the auto-reply email immediate and not block it on owner assignment
priya: long-term we still need better retries and jitter in enrichment, but for this incident let's: 1) deploy backstop-assigner (assign after 180s), 2) add reconciliation job to re-run enrichment and update owner when available, 3) add HubSpot fallback rule for 5m as a belt-and-suspenders
mike: agree. I'll open GH PR for enrichment: add RETRIES=2 with exponential backoff and JITTER=true. snippet:
```
RETRIES=2
RETRY_BASE_MS=250
RETRY_JITTER=true
```
zoe: backstop-assigner will be a small lambda that watches for new leads with no owner and created_via = "webinar-form". If age > 180s set owner = `unclaimed-webinar` and add timeline note: "provisional owner - pending enrichment"
evan: important: make sure provisional owners don't sync to SF as permanent owners. Sales sync should map `unclaimed-*` to a queue owner in Salesforce or skip until reconciliation
sales-bot: Created SF sync ticket SF-990 to handle provisional owner mapping and prevent accidental territory assignment
priya: datadog: add a panel `lead.handoff.provisional.count` and alert if provisional_count > 50 for > 20m. Also add `lead.enrichment.errors` spike alert
mike: canary deploying enrichment patch now. ops-bot: deploy request for enrichment-service v3.6-canary
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: enrichment-service v3.6-canary by mike at 1799991280
mike: canary logs show success rate up from 88% -> 98% on canary instances. rolling to main in 10m if steady
zoe: I pushed PR for backstop-assigner GH-7001. It includes a reconciliation cron job and idempotency checks. Will schedule a small run at 20:00 PT for the recent 24h window
evan: SLA to put in the playbook: webinar handoff target = 90% assigned (provisional or final) < 3m, 99% < 12m. Reconciliation should settle final owner within 24h
priya: also add runbook step: if provisional_count > 200, pause provisional assignments and open incident — that means enrichment is degraded and we need ops oncall
mike: ops-bot: deploying backstop-assigner v1.0 at 1799991375
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: backstop-assigner v1.0 by zoe at 1799991380
zoe: ran a smoke backfill for the last 6h; adjusted 42 leads to provisional owner and wrote timeline note "assigned by backstop-assigner; will reconcile"
sales-bot: Notified Salesforce queue owners about provisional assignments; SDRs will triage flagged leads in #sdr-inbound at 18:00 PT
priya: adding test cases to GH-7001: ensure provisional owner is marked as provisional flag and not synced as permanent, ensure reconciliation updates owner and appends timeline note
evan: great work. follow-ups: mike to confirm enrichment rollout, zoe to own backstop monitoring and reconciliation job, priya to update playbook and Datadog tiles
mike: will monitor for 2 hours and post metrics to the marketing channel
evan: thanks all — quick triage and good incremental solution :thumbsup:
